text: This report seeks authorization from the Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo to negotiate an extension to the agreement with the Toronto Zoo's current vendor for the provision of food services.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Authorized the Chief Transformation Officer, or his designate to negotiate and execute an extension to the existing food services management agreement consistent with the recommended terms contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 8, 2026) from the Chief Executive Officer, Toronto Zoo and in a form satisfactory to the City Solicitor. 2. Directed the Chief Transformation Officer to incorporate any budgetary changes required upon the adoption of Recommendation 1 above as part of the 2027 budget process. 3. Directed that the confidential information contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 8, 2026) from the Chief Executive Officer, Toronto Zoo remain confidential in its entirety, as it contains information about an ongoing negotiation that affects the Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo.
